extractions.description: An empirical reinforcement-learning study of fine-tuning and knowledge-retention procedures across NetHack, Montezuma’s Revenge, robotic manipulation, and toy environments, with emphasis on the computational artifacts and run configurations used.

type.quote: Through a detailed empirical analysis of the challenging NetHack and Montezuma’s Revenge environments, we show that standard knowledge retention techniques mitigate the problem
